A2.evidence: Ran the frozen simulation for 16 matched seeds each of informed, greedy, whisper-spam and roundtrip. Median fortunes were 627451, 50803, 264736 and 627451 respectively; 4895 round-trip/split/alternating trade probes produced zero positive returns. Sixteen matched seeds and four automated policies are evidence against the tested loops, not exhaustive balance proof.

strengths: Distinct, cohesive lantern-lit flooded-city identity across title, map, goods, characters, events and ending.
Exceptionally informative trade sheets: exact proceeds/profit, cost line, market depth, remaining resources and dated comparison quotes.
Purpose-built phone controls and a spatial map remain usable down to 360x640; desktop keyboard play is practical.
Complete offline game with meaningful debt, finite depth, events, progression, persistence and a clear final ledger.
Matched-seed probes distinguish planning from greedy play and found no profitable tested round-trip exploit.
weaknesses: Phone destination UI omits the supply/import identities promised by onboarding and shown on desktop.
Small, low-contrast quote-age labels undermine an otherwise excellent price hierarchy.
A poor conservative run can spend all thirty nights in debt without reaching upgrades; repeated interruption/result cards amplify the grind.
Accrued interest is mislabeled as paid in the ending; rapid toast feedback can trail the action it explains.
Audible quality and real-iPhone behaviour remain unverified.

The card gives risk/services, and details gives eight unknown observations, but neither gives the district's usual cheap/dear goods. Read layered synthesis and ambience code, but these checks establish execution/policy only, not perceived sound quality, real-iPhone playback or silent-switch behaviour.
evidence.screenshot_inspection: Every screenshot listed above was personally opened with view_image; interpretation is my judgment. Also inspected the regression full-run-ending and sandbox screenshots: they captured transition/background states, so I did not use them as visual proof of a final score or fully settled sandbox UI. evidence.abuse_fixtures: Kept separate from scored touch play. Frozen verify.cjs corrupts saved data, checks a late-rate day-15 fixture and runs an allow-scripts/storage-blocked sandbox. Frozen roundtrip policy performs labelled economic exploit probes. No game resources, active RNG state, pending outcomes or hidden future prices were read/mutated to guide scored UI play. The touch helper's seeded startup and animation-only FAST flag are declared test conditions.
execution_model_issues: Executed as gpt-6.1-sol; no provider/model substitution, delegation or subagents.
Used only packet tools; did not read root tools, prior judging, GOALS.md, other judges or git history. Explicitly required fleet documents were the only non-packet reference reads.
Applied the documented mise binary+shims PATH for Node; no dependency installation needed.
A phone target-marker lookup timed out after immediate resize/view switching; delayed retry worked, no page error or game soft-lock.

My first deposit typing step appended 100 to the prefilled amount instead of selecting it, so the UI correctly clamped and deposited all 808. I then used Control+A to withdraw exactly 100 and repay exactly 50. This was my automation input mistake, not a resource-integrity failure.
No real iPhone, audible quality assessment, screen-reader run, software keyboard or long-session memory profile.
Both step harnesses were stopped (9462 and 9472); touch, verification and strategy browsers exited through their cleanup paths. No game/helper or git writes.

verdict: 83.5/100. An unusually coherent and readable single-file trading game with strong touch execution and informative trade sheets. The largest design defect is the phone map's missing district trade identities; low-contrast quote ages and an inaccurate interest label are smaller polish gaps. Required full touch and regression games completed, with no demonstrated soft-lock or tested money exploit. Audio quality and physical-iPhone behaviour remain unverified.
